Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: APAC demo window + US->EU handoff plan

Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for the interest and for locking in time to see Redwood. I pulled a couple of candidate slots that try to balance: (a) your team's APAC morning preference, (b) Lauren's early afternoon in Europe (for a live handoff), and (c) a reasonable time for me to introduce/record the SDR portion from the US.

Proposal (all times on Friday 20 May):
- Option A — 09:30 SGT / 02:30 BST / 19:30 PDT (Thu) — customer morning, EU very early — not ideal for Lauren
- Option B — 13:00 SGT / 06:00 BST / 23:00 PDT (Thu) — customer early afternoon, EU morning start, US late — workable if Lauren can do early BST
- Option C — 20:00 SGT / 13:00 BST / 04:00 PDT — accommodates EU midday handoff but pushes the customer late

Two operational asks:
1) If we choose Option B, I propose the flow: 10 mins opening/context from me (recorded), live demo with Lauren for 30 mins, then 15 mins Q&A and next-steps with both on the call so we have a real-time handoff.
2) If Option A is chosen, I'll do a condensed 5-min intro and record a short snippet so Lauren can join 10–15 mins in for the deep product walk.

Note: daylight saving differences mean the US/EU offsets are asymmetric right now — I flagged the BST/PDT offsets in the calendar ICS I attached.

I attached the latest proposal deck and a calendar ICS with the three candidates. Please let me know which option works best for you and if we should route this to a different stakeholder at ClearSight.

Cheers,
Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposal-v2.pdf (slides), calendar-candidate-times.ics

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for these options and for the clear flow. Our team prefers a morning slot in Singapore (our engineers are most available then). Option A (09:30 SGT) would be ideal on our side.

Two constraints to flag:
- We need at least 20 minutes at the end of the call with our technical lead (Tim) for network/security Qs.
- If Lauren can't join the whole demo, can we at minimum have her available for the core demo + Q&A (approx 35–45 mins total)?

If Option A is the only feasible slot for ClearSight, we can make that work. I see you mentioned recording — we are generally fine with recordings for handoffs.

Sophia
